/interest: Merged into the home page at the owner's instruction: 'there will no longer be 2 landing pages, just the home page acting as the landing page with the main header as [the interest page's] header.' Nothing was deleted — every heading, drawing, answer panel and the form itself are now rendered into "/" by build/interest.js's interestParts(). The URL 301s to "/" WITH its query string intact (server.js LEGACY_REDIRECTS), so /interest?state=ok&t=<token> — the only copy of a removal token that will ever exist, because nothing here sends email — still lands on the answer it was going to. Not a 410: nothing was withdrawn on editorial or regulatory grounds, and the content is still published, at a different address.
